title: A decentralized method for making sensor measurements tamper-proof to support open science applications
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical solution to ensure data integrity and prevent manipulation in open science. While this addresses ethical concerns in scientific practice (e.g., preventing fraudulent data), it does not evaluate or benchmark ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/faith concepts as its primary subject matter. It provides a means to uphold scientific ethics, rather than analyzing or benchmarking ethics itself.
